summary: I inspected 12 representative files from the 45 changed/added files in this work unit. All files contain formal HOL4 mathematical content including datatype definitions, function definitions with termination proofs, theorems with proofs, and compiler translation specifications. The files span basis libraries (List, Map, String), pure libraries (int, map, string), compiler bootstrap translations (32-bit and 64-bit compiler, parser, dec), and verified examples (grep, pseudo-boolean encodings, SAT encodings). Every file examined contains definitions, statements, proofs, or interfaces relevant to formal mathematics search. No files meet the high evidence bar for hard exclusion per FILTER-002 and FILTER-004.
